**AC:** QA scenario 3 with clock-warped tests; the day-90 rule never fires earlier.

title: US-11.5 · Cancel ≠ delete: services keep running and metering after cancellation
body: **AC:** B12 contract: what stops vs what keeps running+billing; Resume/Restart one click.

title: US-11.6 · Invoice grammar == estimate grammar; lines sum; integer cents end-to-end
body:
ADR-025; fixes the B3 canon defect per the S5 ruling.
**AC:** shared pricing table is the single source; invariant tests at estimate, invoice, and console layers.

title: T11.1 · Pricing + quota tables as data
body: **AC:** one table consumed by estimate engine, quota evaluator, and invoice generator.

title: T11.2 · Subscription state machine (trial, anchor, dunning, cancelled_at_anchor)
body: **AC:** all states from models.md enums reachable and tested; B9–B12 flows backed.

title: T11.3 · Invoice generator (accrue → open → paid/failed)
body: **AC:** lines carry usage_ref; totals in integer cents; monthly close idempotent.

title: T11.4 · Payment provider integration
body:
Razorpay vs Stripe vs both — founder call by Sprint 11 (partner geography; INR-first suggests Razorpay + Stripe intl).
**AC:** add/replace card; charge; webhook → dunning transitions.

title: T11.5 · Quota evaluator middleware (soft confirm=true path; hard 402/429 catalog)
body: **AC:** soft overage proceeds only on confirm=true with overage_price_cents; hard fails with remediation.

title: T11.6 · Budget endpoint + billing exports
body:
PUT /orgs/{org}/billing/budget + PDF/CSV exports (spec-change §2d, per ruling).
**AC:** B1 set-budget and B3/B4 export surfaces unblocked.

title: T12.1 · Policies CRUD + versioning + dry-run impact preview
body:
`?dry_run=true` returns impact without creating (G9–G11 wizard contract).
**AC:** versions retained; last_change_event linked; violation counts on the spine.

title: T12.2 · Policy enforcement wiring + tighten-only property tests
body:
Closest-wins inheritance; org sets floors/ceilings; env-sensitive restrictions are policies, never role rows.
**AC:** denial problem+json names the policy; property test: no widening.

title: T12.3 · ai-assistant policy (enabled | opt_in | disabled)
body: **AC:** disable gates all /assistant/* (404 empty-equivalent per yaml); deletes nothing; instant re-enable (Law 4).

title: T12.4 · Templates: capture + consume with secret-stripping checked at write
body:
Frozen copy, never a live link (ADR-021); excluded-service bindings become required inputs; estimate at save/list/consume.
**AC:** QA scenario 5 — contents contain zero secret material (DB-level check); deleting a used template leaves instantiations untouched.

title: T12.5 · Template refresh-as-new-version
body: **AC:** POST /templates/{tpl}/refresh mints a new version; used_by_count preserved.

title: T12.6 · Dashboards CRUD + widgets (scope ⊥ visibility)
body:
Scope org|project orthogonal to visibility personal|org|restricted; dashboards read, never provision.
**AC:** project-scoped born filtered; org-wide renders only viewer-accessible projects and says so.

title: T12.7 · Prebuilt dashboards (generated views) + share/fork/duplicate
body:
Fork-to-customize, never files; :fork/:duplicate/widget-delete/share grants per spec-change §2c ruling.
**AC:** DB2/3/5/7 surfaces unblocked; edits to shared dashboards audited.

title: US-13.1 · No auto-apply path exists in the API (architecture, not policy)
body:
Applying a proposal is a normal human-session call re-running the full two-layer RBAC for the underlying change (`ai.apply_proposal` = per underlying action).
**AC:** constructing an AI-applied mutation fails at the type level — no such endpoint.

title: US-13.2 · Every claim cites evidence ids; id-only envelopes + RBAC-scoped resolver
body:
Law 2 + Law 3: context envelopes carry ids only; resolver fetches at prompt-fill time within viewer scope; answers without citable evidence say so.
**AC:** evidence kinds metric|trace|log|query_plan|config|cost|schema|event resolvable end-to-end.

title: US-13.3 · Insights with severity/evidence/hypothesis; drafting refuses off-allowlist classes
body:
Org-wide scans; evidence re-checked against viewer scope at read time; no IAM/secrets/network/destructive proposals ever.
**AC:** allowlist refusal tested; per-read scope re-check tested.

title: US-13.4 · AI disable: every surface hidden instantly, nothing deleted, platform byte-identical
body: **AC:** QA scenario 7 — Create/Observe/Deploy/Settings byte-identical with AI off; re-enable restores threads.

title: US-13.5 · Dismiss requires a logged reason; applies audit as 'applied as <user>, via assistant'
body: **AC:** events carry via=assistant provenance; dismiss-reason required at the API.

title: T13.1 · The 8 read-only tools as internal RBAC-scoped services
body:
get_metrics, get_logs, get_trace, get_config, get_events, get_billing_summary, price_estimate, draft_proposal. No mutating tool exists.
**AC:** each tool provably scoped to the viewer's RBAC.

title: T13.2 · Resolver + server-side prompt templates (12-ai)
body:
Ask / insight-generation / proposal-drafting / describe-to-provision templates; four-laws system prompt.
**AC:** prompts live server-side; envelope ids resolved fresh per call.

title: T13.3 · Threads + messages store (retained-but-hidden under disable)
body:
Drawer and workspace share one thread; attach-insight pins evidence (AI9).
**AC:** disable hides, never deletes; re-enable restores.

title: T13.4 · Insight generator job + store
body:
{severity, evidence[], hypothesis}; categories reliability|performance|cost|security.
**AC:** insights only from telemetry the org actually has; snooze with duration (spec-change §3).

title: T13.5 · Proposal store + human-session apply flow
body:
W10 order: evidence[] → reasoning → proposed_change → impact{cost_delta, risk, blast_radius}; statuses open|applied|dismissed|snoozed.
**AC:** apply returns 403 when caller lacks the underlying permission.

title: T13.6 · Inference via bought API behind a swappable interface
body:
D5: buy inference, build the citation/evidence machinery.
**AC:** provider swap is a config change; AI requests metered ($2/1k quota).

title: T13.7 · Describe-to-provision (AI1): intent → services[] + estimate; unknowns → questions
body:
Never guesses; each service carries why + shape + estimate; totals through the one estimate engine.
**AC:** provisioning still goes through the human estimate-accept gate.

title: T14.2 · pg_stat_statements insights endpoint
body:
D4 rows.
**AC:** GET /services/{svc}/insights; viewer-scoped.

body:
D3 browse, TTL edit (write-unlock for TTL only in wave 1).
**AC:** GET /keys + PATCH /keys/{key}.

body:
D8/D18 read surfaces; redrive/discard/purge are wave 2.
**AC:** GET /messages?state= with payloads.

body:
D5/W5; also unblocks CLI `db branch`. Restore-to-branch (never in place) is wave 2.
**AC:** GET /backups; GET/POST /branches; branch create = Neon timeline.

redrive/discard/purge, FLUSHALL, restore-to-branch, shell exec (audited, TTL'd unlock), branch promote/delete.
**AC:** every verb policy-gated, typed-confirmed where destructive, audited with blast radius.

bindings :rotate, domain recheck/delete, schedule/lifecycle per-row ops + :run, deployment :pause/:abort, org/project :transfer, git integration, cell :drain/:detach — sequenced by blocked-surface count (proposals §9).

Handlers validated against openapi.yaml (schema round-trip); console/CLI/SDK clients rebuilt on any yaml change.

Full rbac-matrix.csv × endpoint sweep; tighten-only property tests; denials name role/policy (E3 grammar).

16-qa's 15-line list: keyboard-only, focus trap, contrast, plus every flow family.
**AC:** one command produces the release report.

Monthly: env rebuild (inv. 3), tenant restore-and-diff (inv. 9), control-plane DB restore (inv. 10).

problem+json 4xx/5xx + latency injection, generalizing the audit's fetch-wrapper.

Dunning/anchor/proration tests never wait real time.
**AC:** QA scenarios 3/4 run in seconds under the harness.

GitHub Actions → build → sign → deploy via the platform's own reconciler manifests; zero static SA keys incl. CI.
